normalized_text: Apollo 4 was the first all-up test of the three-stage Saturn V rocket. Apollo 5 was the first test flight of the Lunar Module. Apollo 6 was the final qualification of the Saturn V launch vehicle and Apollo spacecraft for crewed missions. Apollo 7 lifted off on October 11, 1968, for a ten-day flight in Earth orbit. Frank Borman, James Lovell, and William Anders made the first crewed mission to the vicinity of the Moon on Apollo 8.
